notablePrerequisites: You have no more than five cards in hand.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Noetic Scales triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Repeat each turn.
